summary.headline: Dorotheus and Astrological Lots
summary.text: Catalog entries for folios 126v–145v covering profit, the lot of substance, a poem to Emperor Manuel by John Kamateros, and astrological works of Dorotheus on judgments, illness, decumbitures, vomiting, lots, journeys, houses, and related questions, with sources attributed partly to Hephaestion of Thebes.
